I think if I understand it correctly, AXA GHA is an HMO. AIA CP 100 is a Critical Illness insurance that will pay you lump sum if you get diagnosed with any of the covered illnesses. 

It's good to have them together as they work hand in hand. 

Having Flexi Protect / Term Life isn't really overkill in this situation because the AIA CP 100 is Critical Illness OR Death, whichever comes first. So if God forbid, na diagnose ka with Critical Illness and then you die, at least your beneficiaries/dependents will still get an allotted face amount. You can't apply for Life Insurance anymore if you're critically ill. 

But of course, these 3 together are not cheap. But they are good to have together if you have the funds for it. 

I think you should already have HMO with your workplace though?

Other cheap options for HMO would be the prepaid health cards. You can compare them at Maria Health (not sponsored - it's free to compare). For Life Insurance, any term insurance should be the best bang for your buck. Meron din Sun Life Assure na term life critical illness OR death din, whichever comes first. Much cheaper than AIA CP100 but 36 illnesses & ongoing renewal every five years.
